name: anhedral
description: Scaffold the Anhedral Stack and connect projects, configuration, deployments and logs through Platform.

interface.longDescription: Generate the Anhedral Stack as editable web UI, then add backend services, private storage and Stripe when needed. Optionally connect Platform through OAuth for project configuration, deployment receipts and logs. Secrets stay in the browser and Platform.
defaultPrompt: Initialize the Anhedral Stack, start it locally and open it in my browser.
